category_title: Students who procrastinate on work plans until the final deadline
scenario_title: Low-achieving student struggling to initiate multi-week work plan
minimal_context: The student is sitting in a study lesson with a new multi-week work plan for math and science.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Here is the new math and science work plan for the next three weeks. You can go ahead and start working at your own pace.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Puts the work plan on the desk and stares at it without opening the book) Okay.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What do you think you will work on first?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't know. I normally procrastinate because I struggle to get started.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Well, just try your best to get something done during this study lesson.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Leans back in the chair) This is how I normally work: At school, the first couple of weeks, I do nothing. I'll just delay the work plan until the last few days.
